methodology: Glucose Goddess — structure meals to blunt blood-glucose spikes: eat vegetables/fibre first, keep breakfast savoury and protein-rich, add a little vinegar or fat to carbs, and move gently after eating.

components.portion: 2 eggs OR 2 slices of smoked salmon OR a protein serving
1 cup strawberries/raspberries/blueberries OR 1 peach OR 1/2 banana OR 2 kiwis OR 1 orange OR 1 apple
1 cup kefir with skim milk OR 3/4 cup Greek yogurt
1 cup cooked vegetables OR 2 cups raw
180 g chicken OR fish OR turkey OR pork loin OR beef (in sauce, grilled, or oven-baked)
1/2 cup whole-grain pasta or quinoa OR 1 sweet potato OR 1 potato with skin OR 2 corn tortillas
1/3 cup lentils OR 1/4 cup hummus OR 1/3 cup chickpeas
1 cup strawberries/raspberries/blueberries OR 1 peach OR 1/2 banana
2 tsp olive oil OR 2 tsp sesame oil
20 g almonds/walnuts/cashews/pistachios + 1 apple OR 1 pear OR 1 nectarine
1 cup vegetables - baby carrots and cherry tomatoes
1 can tuna OR 1 egg + 30 g cheese OR 2 slices turkey ham or chicken + 30 g cheese OR 90 g chicken + 30 g cheese
1 whole-grain pita OR 50 g whole-grain sourdough bread

prescribed_foods: vegetables/fibre first at each meal (Glucose Goddess)
lean proteins: chicken, fish, turkey, pork loin, beef
whole grains and sourdough over refined starches
notes: Imported from the NutriPrep parse of the nutritionist's sheet. The sheet lists portions rather than numbers, so the macro targets were worked out from the prescribed meals rather than stated by the clinician - check them, and re-photograph the plan in Settings if the numbers should be different. Hydration target is the sum of the water the plan asks for at each meal (2000 ml).
